title: Ondo button
description: Flat, quiet buttons with an 8px radius in three heights (36, 44 and 48px): a solid fill in the primary colour (near-black on light, pale grey inside dark bands) that dims to 80% on hover, and a soft translucent variant for secondary actions like 'Read more'.
notes: inside a block with the dark class the solid button turns pale grey with black text, as on the original's black bands
name: ondo-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: solid: primary fill · soft: a translucent ink wash (secondary actions)

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 36px tall (nav, cards) · md: 44px (section actions) · lg: 48px (full-width on phones)

props.name: onClick
props.description: called on click (only when it renders a button)
